data: In fiscal 2024, which ended June 30, 2024, Microsoft reported revenue of about $245.1 billion, up roughly 16% from $211.9 billion in fiscal 2023. Gross profit was about $171.0 billion, a gross margin of roughly 69.8%, compared with about 68.9% in fiscal 2023. Operating income was about $109.4 billion, an operating margin of roughly 44.6%, up from about 41.8% the year before. These figures come from Microsoft's fiscal 2024 Form 10-K as I recall it, and you should check them against the filing if you need exact numbers.
